contract.search: Complete A/E/O mappings over 21 main keys, at most two carriers, at three M41 frontier final maps. Then up to six cost-leader local descents with final moves/swaps/group swaps and carrier moves. Selected joint final/carrier proposals permit memory-repair intermediates, followed by up to four leader rings. Finite search.

independentMemory.formula: M = ordinary_displacement_links + retroflex_links + YW_nonidentity_links + AEO_carriers + nonidentity_final_links + initial_extra_routes + final_extra_routes
independentMemory.scope: common399; normalized written tails with j/q/x/Y-u restored as v; er explicit; iu/ui/un retained
independentMemory.policy: Each nonidentity mapping costs one. An ordinary displaced initial is already charged; no second default fee. A/E/O shared physical carrier counted once. Every additional key within a head/final costs one routing item. Optional aliases included only where authoritative source is supplied.

scope: Non-A/E/O initial mappings fixed to U7E; traditional actual 21x21 and full explicit M<=42 audit. Complete at-most-two-carrier assignments at the three recorded M41 final maps. Later finite carrier/final leader descent and selected joint memory-repair proposals may include a third carrier only when final-map savings keep total M<=42. Not exhaustive joint search, global optimality, or robust auxiliary-policy optimization. Finalists have full point-optimal policy enumeration or hash-verified identical-map reuse.
